name: AQUA BLUE
source:
Every year there is a nationwide high school girl contest. The winner will have a chance to make an idol debut backed by the event's sponsor. However this year's contest has a new sponsor and things are slightly different this time around...

[from [url=http://densetsu.com/display.php?id=542&style=alphabetical]AnimeDensetsu[/url]]
translation:
每年都会举办全国高中女生大赛，冠军有机会在活动赞助商支持下以偶像身份出道。然而，今年的比赛换了一位新赞助商，情况也与往年略有不同…

[摘自[url=http://densetsu.com/display.php?id=542&style=alphabetical]AnimeDensetsu[/url]]
